description: Explain a confirmed transaction in plain language: category (swap, SOL transfer, meme-coin trade), success or failure, fee, slot, time, each account's SOL balance change, and raw logs. Use it to check what a transaction actually did. Example: {"signature":"<transaction signature>"} Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Calls that return an error are not charged.

network.description: Cluster to query: "mainnet-beta" (real funds; the default) or "devnet" (test network). Optional.

signature.description: Signature of a confirmed transaction: base58 string, about 88 characters; get one from get_recent_transactions (required).

name: decode_tx
